name: ROGUE
source:
You're an Inspector for Vardyger Corporation, the largest technological company among the stars. As an Inspector, you sacrificed your entire life to uphold Vardyger's supremacy by destroying counterfeit products, smashing competition to bits, taking care of rogue facilities, and making sure that nobody stands in the way of progress and order.

But your time is up now - someone hacked his way into your brain... and there's nothing you can do to stop him from completely frying it.

[From [url=https://naarel.itch.io/rogue]Itch.io[/url]]
